A short teaser introduces a separate report.

Bridge inspection restores the morning bus route

Engineers reopened the bridge on Wednesday after inspecting its supports and testing the repaired road surface. The work restores a direct bus route for residents who had used a longer diversion during the closure. The published inspection report describes the checks and explains which maintenance work remains.

ADVERTISING_NOT_ARTICLE This promotion contains unrelated offers rather than any bridge inspection evidence.

The council said that buses would return to their usual timetable the next morning. Drivers must still observe the temporary weight restriction while crews finish work beside the northern approach. Inspectors will return next month to compare their measurements with the readings taken before the road reopened.

The first speaker asked the council to publish the remaining maintenance dates so passengers could plan their journeys.

The next speaker said the reopened route would reduce the time needed to reach the local hospital.

  • Morning services will use the bridge from the first scheduled departure, with stops remaining in their usual locations.

  • Evening services retain the published timetable, and the council will announce any further closure before maintenance starts.
